name: YouTube Music
description: Adds YouTube Music search, browsing and playback to Swayve.

settings.label: YouTube Music session cookie
settings.description: Paste the cookie from a browser signed into music.youtube.com. Lets Swayve see your liked songs; stored on this device and never sent anywhere else.

settings.label: YouTube channel ID (optional)
settings.description: Only needed if your liked songs live on a secondary YouTube channel rather than your account's default one. Use the bookmarklet below on music.youtube.com to find it. Leave blank to use your default channel.

settings.label: Include YouTube videos
settings.description: Search video uploads as well as the official catalogue. Finds remixes, demos, live versions and unreleased tracks that were never put on a streaming service.

settings.label: Region
settings.description: Catalogue region sent to YouTube Music. Availability is regional.
